_about: Lamp Square's twelve window lamps (docs/maps/harrow_landing.md). Each is its own light switch: lit when its 'lit_if' condition holds (an empty one is always lit). Start of the game: 6 lit (win_01, 04, 06, 08, 10, 12), 6 dark. On the walk home (beat b3) the scenes relight_win_02 / 07 / 11 set win_02_lit / win_07_lit / win_11_lit as Red crosses the square; win_03 lights when job_dark_window_done is set.

win_02.note: dark until the walk home (beat b3), lit by the relight scene

win_03.note: the window above the store: lit by the side job

win_07.note: dark until the walk home (beat b3), lit by the relight scene

win_11.note: dark until the walk home (beat b3), lit by the relight scene
